compiled_state.title: T2: GREEN — Implement second-source verification agent + self-application validation
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Goal
Create plugins/dso/agents/second-source-verifier.md — an independent agent that audits all story closure artifacts in the epic and confirms typed-enum verifier, renderer, and handoff gate were actually used (not just present in code).

## Files to Create
- plugins/dso/agents/second-source-verifier.md

## Agent Procedure
1. For each closed story in epic: read closure artifact (ticket comments or verifier JSON)
2. Confirm P1 field present (typed-enum verifier used)
3. Confirm closure narrative sourced from render-closure-narrative.sh (not LLM prose)
4. Confirm handoff gate evidence between story pairs
5. Produce structured report: {story_id, verifier_used: bool, renderer_used: bool, gate_enforced: bool}
6. Overall: exits 0 if all mechanisms confirmed for all stories; exits 1 with finding list otherwise

## Acceptance Criteria
- bash tests/scripts/test-second-source-verification.sh exits 0 (all 6 cases GREEN)
- grep -c 'second-source-verifier\|second_source' plugins/dso/agents/second-source-verifier.md should be at least 1

## Testing Mode
GREEN (new agent file + wrapper; depends S11/T1)
